faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before starting your learning journey.

items.question: Do you offer one-on-one lessons or group classes?
items.answer: We offer both options. You can choose one-on-one lessons for personalized attention or join small group classes with no more than 5 students to ensure a high-quality learning experience.

items.question: How can I choose the most suitable lesson schedule?
items.answer: Our academy operates 24/7 to accommodate students across different time zones. After registering, you can choose the lesson times that best fit your daily schedule.

items.question: What qualifications do your teachers have?
items.answer: All of our teachers are certified in Quran recitation and memorization by recognized institutions, including Al-Azhar, and have extensive experience teaching both children and adults online.

items.question: Do you offer a free trial lesson?
items.answer: Yes! We offer a completely free trial lesson for all new students. It allows you to assess your level and experience our teaching approach before subscribing to any plan.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept credit and debit cards, PayPal, and direct bank transfers, making it easy for students around the world to subscribe to our programs.

about.heroDescription: Noor Platform is a mission-driven ecosystem built to connect specialized, certified Muslim educators holding traditional authorizations (Ijazah) with eager students worldwide. We offer a safe, structured, and authentic environment that bridges classical Islamic scholarship with state-of-the-art virtual classroom technology.

mohamed.bio: Drives the platform's long-term strategic vision, annual objectives, and institutional growth. Directs day-to-day global operations, financial reporting, and the strict vetting frameworks governing certified Ijazah validation and oral admission testing.

alHassan.bio: Architects the platform's technical core and virtual classroom features. Orchestrates real-time interactive audio/video engines, automated timezone-shifting calendars, and absolute infrastructure security complying strictly with global GDPR data protection standards.

curriculum.sectionDescription: A precise, structured curriculum designed to take students from absolute zero foundational rules up to chains of transmission (Isnad) back to the Prophet (ﷺ).
curriculum.recitationDesc: Master proper articulation points (Makharij), rules of NunSakinah, Madd, and rhythmic recitation styles from certified teachers.
curriculum.hifzDesc: Structured memorization schedules adapted to your individual capacity, complete with systemic review cycles and performance mapping.
curriculum.arabicDesc: Comprehensive conversational fluency, vocabulary building, and syntax/morphology (Nahw & Sarf) to comprehend Arabic texts directly.
curriculum.understandingDesc: Delve into the linguistic analysis of the Quranic text along with essential contextual commentary (Tafsir) to enrich daily practice.

rules.sectionDesc: Noor Platform operates under strict structural governance rules to protect both academic truth and the privacy of our global student body.
rules.academicAuthDesc: Teachers must undergo strict authentication checks on credentials and an audio recitation assessment by our expert quality team prior to onboarding.
rules.familyFirstDesc: Parents have complete visibility via administrative dashboards to track class records, text messaging streams, and technical progress maps for minors under 16.

whyUs.title: Why Choose Noor Academy for Online Quran Learning?
whyUs.subtitle: Committed to Student Progress and Teacher Excellence
whyUs.description: We Care the most about Students' real progress and our teachers' high performance who are highly qualified, certified, holding Ijazah of Quran and graduated from Al-Azhar University. That is all for reaching the highest quality for best online learning experience.

features.supportDesc: Fast communication from students to administration and between students and teachers as well. Students call, chat or email us anytime during the day we'll respond promptly.
features.qualityDesc: Providing best quality and highest qualifications for a successful online learning. presenting a unique value of teaching with high progress to meet students' expectations.
features.teachersDesc: Native Arabic Speakers (Egyptians) holding Ijazah of Quran in many Qira'at from Al-Azhar University with a great teaching experience (male & female) teachers for both kids and adults.
features.reportsDesc: Students' progress tracking is one of the most priorities of the quality system in the academy. Homework, exams & competitions are held for enhancing students' performance.
features.facilitiesDesc: For busy parents & students, we help them though all enrollment steps and the learning journey. Students receive a Certificate for passing each level.
features.guaranteeDesc: If a student wanted to stop the classes for any reason, we guarantee a refund for all the classes that were not done. you can also check our refund policy.
